title: Conformational Sampling of CPT1A Enables Dynamic Structure-Based Ligand Screening.
authors: Zhang, Sijia; Zhang, Yingbo; Zhao, Jiasheng; Long, Jiangang; Zhang, Lei; Yang, Zhiwei
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟、马尔可夫状态模型和虚拟筛选对CPT1A进行构象采样与动态结构基配体筛选，核心聚焦蛋白质构象计算与结构预测，方法上结合物理模拟与对接，虽对象为膜蛋白但问题和方法高度契合本课题。
abstract: Carnitine palmitoyltransferase 1A (CPT1A) catalyzes a rate-limiting step in fatty acid beta-oxidation and is a target for studies of metabolic disease and cancer. However, the structural dynamics of CPT1A remain poorly understood due to the lack of full-length structure. In this study, we employed an integrated computational approach combining molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, Markov state models (MSMs), and binding free energy calculations to elucidate the conformational landscape of human CPT1A. We performed an all-atom MD simulation of CPT1A embedded in a realistic outer mitochondrial membrane, and root-mean-square fluctuation (RMSF)-guided local region analysis coupled with MSM transition-path analysis and GROMOS clustering convergently identified a representative conformation. The pathway probabilities reported here describe dominant local transitions within specific mobile segments rather than the global equilibrium population of the full-length protein. Using this representative conformation, we performed a virtual screening of over 1.23 million compounds from the ChemDiv library, followed by Lipinski filtering, yielding five candidates with docking scores below -10 kcal/mol. Subsequent MD simulations and binding free energy calculations confirmed stable binding, with Compound 2 exhibiting the most favorable free energy of -25.99 kcal/mol. Principal component analysis (PCA) and secondary-structure analyses revealed ligand-specific modulation of CPT1A dynamics. A preliminary in vitro CPT1 activity assay revealed candidate-specific responses, and the free-energy and activity data were partially consistent. These results provide a dynamically informed structural basis for CPT1A ligand recognition, identify candidates with distinct energetic and functional profiles, and establish an integrated strategy for ligand discovery in structurally uncharacterized proteins.
abstract_zh: 肉碱棕榈酰转移酶1A（CP1A）催化脂肪酸β-氧化中的限速步骤，是代谢疾病和癌症研究的一个靶点。然而，由于缺乏全长结构，CPT1A的结构动力学仍知之甚少。在本研究中，我们采用了一种整合计算策略，结合分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟、马尔可夫状态模型（Markov state models, MSMs）和结合自由能计算，以阐明人CPT1A的构象景观。我们在真实的外线粒体膜中进行了CPT1A的全原子MD模拟，并通过均方根波动（root-mean-square fluctuation, RMSF）引导的局部区域分析，结合MSM过渡路径分析和GROMOS聚类，收敛性地识别出一个代表性构象。本文报道的路径概率描述了特定可移动片段内的主要局部转变，而非全长蛋白的全局平衡群体。利用该代表性构象，我们对ChemDiv库中超过123万种化合物进行了虚拟筛选，随后进行Lipinski过滤，得到五个对接分数低于-10 kcal/mol的候选物。后续的MD模拟和结合自由能计算确认了稳定结合，其中化合物2表现出最优的自由能-25.99 kcal/mol。主成分分析（principal component analysis, PCA）和二级结构分析揭示了配体特异性对CPT1A动力学的调节。初步的体外CPT1活性测定显示了候选物特异性响应，且自由能与活性数据部分一致。这些结果为CPT1A配体识别提供了动态信息化的结构基础，识别出具有不同能量和功能特征的候选物，并为结构未表征蛋白中的配体发现建立了一种整合策略。
